content: WhatsApp _chat.txt date parsing: no library auto-detects the locale-dependent format. Proven parsers (whatsapp-chat-to-pdf, NeverFar whatsapp-export-parser, whatsapp-wrapped) all use a regex pattern registry tested against the first lines, then parse with a known tokenizer. Recommend date-fns v4 parse + date-fns/locale for construction and Intl.DateTimeFormat for output rendering. Reject luxon (heavy, maintenance-only, no detection), chrono-node (NLP, wrong domain), dayjs (plugin fragmentation).
